name: IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card

localized_names.en: IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR 19.49% to 27.99% variable; cash advance APR 28.74% variable; penalty APR up to 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: Pricing & Terms list foreign transaction fees as None.

base_rate.description: 3X points per $1 on all other purchases.

categories.label: IHG Hotels and Resorts (card earn only)
Dining and all other travel, including rideshare

rewards.redemption_notes: Up to 28X total at IHG including member and Platinum Elite status earn from IHG.

signup_bonus.description: 200,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months, plus 10,000 bonus points after adding an authorized user in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night
benefits.description: Anniversary Free Night each year with a 60,000-point redemption cap, plus an additional free night after spending $40,000 in a calendar year.

benefits.title: IHG Platinum Elite status
benefits.description: Automatic Platinum Elite status while a cardmember, plus 20 Elite Night Credits at account opening and each calendar year.

notes: Issued by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. The product page footnote names both World Mastercard and World Elite Mastercard as trademarks without saying which package this card carries, so network_tier is recorded as none.
